# GENERATED FILE: do not hand edit. Source: tools/spellbook/build_spellbook.py + spellbook_registry.txt
# Root = the viewed character, scope:player = the viewing country.

# ---- Window plumbing. The Spellbook shows the country's selected mage
# (country var omni_sb_selected_mage); the list is rebuilt only when opened.
# The outliner also evaluates visibility when there is no player country.
omni_sb_launcher_visible = {
	scope = province
	saved_scopes = { player }
	is_shown = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:player }
			scope:player = { any_character = { omni_sb_listable_mage = yes } }
		}
		trigger_else = { always = no }
	}
}

omni_sb_open = {
	scope = country
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = { hidden_effect = { omni_sb_refresh_mage_list = yes } }
	ai_is_valid = { always = no }
}

# Character-window shortcut: opens the Spellbook on this character.
omni_sb_open_for_character = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { player }
	is_shown = {
		is_alive = yes
		omni_sb_viewer_controls = yes
		omni_sb_listable_mage = yes
	}
	effect = {
		hidden_effect = {
			save_scope_as = omni_sb_pick
			scope:player = {
				set_variable = { name = omni_sb_selected_mage value = scope:omni_sb_pick }
				omni_sb_refresh_mage_list = yes
			}
		}
	}
	ai_is_valid = { always = no }
}

# Mage list entry: valid (clickable) unless already selected.
omni_sb_select_mage = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { player }
	is_valid = {
		OR = {
			scope:player = { NOT = { has_variable = omni_sb_selected_mage } }
			NOT = { this = scope:player.var:omni_sb_selected_mage }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		hidden_effect = {
			save_scope_as = omni_sb_pick
			scope:player = { set_variable = { name = omni_sb_selected_mage value = scope:omni_sb_pick } }
		}
	}
	ai_is_valid = { always = no }
}

omni_sb_has_selection = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = {
		has_variable = omni_sb_selected_mage
		var:omni_sb_selected_mage = { is_alive = yes }
	}
}

		custom_tooltip = { text = omni_sb_tier_2_tt omni_sb_any_t2_access = yes }

		trigger_else_if = { limit = { OR = { omni_sb_aldic_t2_access = yes } } custom_tooltip = { text = omni_sb_cost_2_tt omni_sb_has_points = { N = 2 } } }

omni_sb_learn_cataclysmic_eruption = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { player }
	is_valid = {
		custom_tooltip = { text = omni_sb_not_yours_tt omni_sb_viewer_controls = yes }
		custom_tooltip = { text = omni_academy_magic_law_tt employer = scope:player omni_can_learn_academy_magic = yes }
		custom_tooltip = { text = omni_sb_known_tt NOT = { has_variable = cataclysmic_eruption_known_var } }
		custom_tooltip = { text = omni_sb_req_melodian_t3_tt omni_sb_knows_melodian_t3 = yes }
		custom_tooltip = { text = omni_sb_tier_4_tt omni_sb_any_t4_access = yes }
		trigger_if = { limit = { omni_sb_can_claim_supreme_cataclysmic_eruption = no }
			trigger_if = { limit = { OR = { omni_sb_melodian_t4_access = yes } } custom_tooltip = { text = omni_sb_cost_5_tt omni_sb_has_points = { N = 5 } } }
			trigger_else = { custom_tooltip = { text = omni_sb_cost_8_tt omni_sb_has_points = { N = 8 } } }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		custom_tooltip = omni_sb_spell_cataclysmic_eruption_tt
		if = { limit = { omni_sb_can_claim_supreme_cataclysmic_eruption = yes } custom_tooltip = omni_sb_supreme_spell_free_tt }
		hidden_effect = { omni_sb_buy_cataclysmic_eruption = yes }
	}
}

omni_sb_has_recipients = {
    scope = country
    is_shown = {
        has_variable_list = omni_sb_recipients
        variable_list_size = { name = omni_sb_recipients value > 0 }
    }
}

omni_sb_clear_recipients = {
    scope = country
    ai_is_valid = { always = no }
    effect = {
        hidden_effect = {
            clear_variable_list = omni_sb_recipients
            remove_variable = omni_sb_casting_mage
        }
    }
}

omni_sb_sort_total_population = {
    scope = country
    ai_is_valid = { always = no }
    effect = {
        hidden_effect = {
            every_in_list = {
                variable = omni_sb_recipients
                root = { add_to_variable_list = { name = omni_sb_sort_buffer target = prev } }
            }
            clear_variable_list = omni_sb_recipients
            ordered_in_list = {
                variable = omni_sb_sort_buffer
                order_by = total_population
                min = 0
                root = { add_to_variable_list = { name = omni_sb_recipients target = prev } }
            }
            clear_variable_list = omni_sb_sort_buffer
        }
    }
}

omni_sb_cast_altered_inspiration = {
    scope = country
    saved_scopes = { player selected_mage target }
    is_valid = { omni_sb_can_cast_altered_inspiration = yes }
    ai_is_valid = { always = no }
    effect = { hidden_effect = {
        scope:player = { trigger_event = { id = omni_spellbook_cast.1 } }
    } }
}

omni_sb_cast_arrows_of_lavas = {
    scope = country

omni_sb_cast_exorcism = {
    scope = country
    saved_scopes = { player selected_mage }
    is_valid = { omni_sb_can_cast_exorcism = yes }
    ai_is_valid = { always = no }
    effect = { hidden_effect = {
        scope:player = {
            clear_variable_list = omni_sb_recipients
            set_variable = { name = omni_sb_casting_mage value = scope:selected_mage }
            every_character = {
                limit = { is_alive = yes }
                save_scope_as = target
                if = { limit = { omni_sb_can_target_exorcism = yes }
                    scope:player = { add_to_variable_list = { name = omni_sb_recipients target = scope:target } }
                }
            }
        }
    } }
}

omni_sb_confirm_exorcism_ii = {
    scope = country
    saved_scopes = { player selected_mage target }
    is_valid = { omni_sb_can_cast_exorcism_ii = yes omni_sb_can_target_exorcism_ii = yes }
    ai_is_valid = { always = no }
    effect = {
        hidden_effect = {
            scope:player = { trigger_event = { id = omni_spellbook_cast.46 } }
            clear_variable_list = omni_sb_recipients
            remove_variable = omni_sb_casting_mage
        }
    }
}

            set_variable = { name = omni_sb_casting_mage value = scope:selected_mage }
            every_owned_province = {
                save_scope_as = target
                if = { limit = { omni_sb_can_target_migration_beacon = yes }
                    scope:player = { add_to_variable_list = { name = omni_sb_recipients target = scope:target } }
                }
            }
        }
    } }
}

                    scope:player = { add_to_variable_list = { name = omni_sb_recipients target = scope:target } }
                }
            }
        }
    } }
